name: gameplay-pacman-coin
origin: A coin eaten in Pac-Man (checkpoint 5, modes), on the round of gameplay-pacman-start (seed 42, Pac-Man, Normal, Cinema, robot 0; the ghosts stopped at the round's first frame): the player walks right from (1,1) (walk, 8 frames on) onto (2,1), where CoinProp.eatProp removes the coin and PacManMode.eatNum writes the player's score (1/119: coinsNum -> scoreData) (coin).
godot_note: Godot starts on the recorded round with the original's Math.random place; the coin is the simulation's pickup.

wall_clock_text./@0#1/@0/time: Game.countTime counts Date seconds; the reference player's Date follows the host clock, not its stepped frames, so TIME differs between the recording and Godot

actions.godot_note: The round this START opens takes its board and enemy robots from the golden of the pacman-start capture (App.round_as_recorded), as gameplay-cinema-start does.
AIControl.stop through the original's own method (fixture); Godot gives the robot no commands, as it then has none.
